newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria calls for repo bids, leaves rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austria calls for repo bids, leaves rates steady.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank on Thursday called for bids on two-week securities repurchase agreements at a fixed and unchanged rate of three percent, adding it was leaving key interest rates steady.
Bids have to be in by 0800 GMT on Friday, the central bank said.
Last week the central bank allotted 7.42 billion schillings in repos, filling six percent of bids.
Austria's discount rate stands at 2.5 percent, its Lombard emergency borrowing rate at 4.75 percent and its Gomex money market rate at 3.4 percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
